response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus

assumptions.assumption: 'Passes the 47.6 cutoff' means strictly greater than 47.6 (bandusagepct > 47.6), not greater than or equal.
A NULL calibration status forms its own group (SQLite GROUP BY keeps NULLs together as one group); NULL bandwidth rows are excluded by the filter.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Passes the cutoff' read inclusively: bandwidth usage at or above 47.6 qualifies.
